item.title: Woman Denied Bond After Deadly Crash In Alamo
item.description: A woman has been arrested after a deadly crash in Alamo. Police were called to the 900 block of Sioux Road early Wednesday after a man was found lying in the road. Elian Ramses Ramirez died before he could be taken to the hospital. Officers arrested 26-year-old Paola Reyes after finding her nearby with damage to the front of her vehicle. Reyes is currently charged with intoxication manslaughter.

item.title: Woman Found Dead In Vehicle In McAllen
item.description: Investigators say there is no sign of foul play after a woman was found dead in a vehicle in McAllen. The 23-year-old was found Wednesday night in the 15-hundred block of South Jackson Road. She did not have a pulse at the time she was found and was pronounced dead at the scene. The cause and manner of the woman’s death are under investigation.

item.title: Gulf Cartel Member Arrested For Human Trafficking In Starr County
item.description: Authorities have arrested an alleged Gulf Cartel member on human trafficking charges. Twenty-four-year-old Juan Gonzalez was arrested after refusing to stop for a Texas Department of Public Safety trooper on Tuesday in Rio Grande City. Three passengers in Gonzalez’s vehicle were identified as being in the U.S. illegally. Investigators later confirmed that Gonzalez was a member of the Gulf Cartel. He’s been charged with multiple counts of human smuggling and evading arrest.

item.title: Israeli Officials: Ayatollah Killed In Strikes
item.description: (Tel Aviv) — Israeli officials say Iran’s Supreme Leader has been killed in joint strikes conducted by the U.S. and Israel. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said earlier there was reason to believe Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed. Multiple reports say Netanyahu was shown a photo of Khamenei’s body. He had ruled over the country since 1989. President Trump had called for a regime change when informing the nation earlier Saturday about major combat operations being launched against Iran

item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio briefed top leaders in Congress on the military action taken against Iran. House Speaker Mike Johnson confirmed the news in a post on X. The Gang of Eight is a group of congressional leaders from both sides of the aisle who are briefed on classified intelligence matters. item.title: FBI Raises Alert Nationwide
item.description: The FBI’s counterterrorism and counterintelligence teams are on elevated alert nationwide. According to Fox News, a bureau official reported the heightened risk. The alert notes a “heightened threat environment” following U.S. military strikes on Iranian nuclear sites. It does not mention any specific planned attacks by pro-Iranian groups.

item.title: The Latest: Iranian State Media Announces Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s Death, Confirming Prior Reports
item.description: By The Associated Press undefined Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in a major attack on Iran launched by Israel and the United States, throwing the future of the Islamic Republic into doubt and raising the risk of regional instability. Iranian state television and the state-run IRNA news announced the 86-year-old’s death early Sunday. President Donald Trump had announced his death hours earlier, saying it gave Iranians their “greatest chance” to “take back” their country.

item.title: US And Israel Clash With Iran At Emergency Security Council Meeting. UN Chief Condemns Attacks
